answers.how: The spacecraft midpoint follows approximately x(t)=692−116t² pixels, giving acceleration 232 px/s². The prior gives a scale of 4/232 m/px; its approximately 342-pixel length converts to 5.9 m.
Using the acceleration-derived scale of 4/232 m/px, the spacecraft's approximately 171-pixel transverse width converts to 2.95 m.
The fitted motion x(t)≈692−116t² gives speed 116 px/s at 0.5 s. Multiplying by 4/232 m/px gives 2 m/s.
The fitted motion gives speed 232 px/s at 1.0 s. Multiplying by the acceleration-derived scale of 4/232 m/px gives 4 m/s.
